greeting.npc: Stop there. Someone left a bomb beside the loading yard. I'm keeping everyone back until I know who can deal with it.

choices.text: What do you know about it?
I won't guess. We'll work from a plan and stop if it doesn't hold up.
Let me handle the bomb. I'll inspect it before attempting to disarm it.

rollText.1: That's the careful approach I needed to hear. Your team may inspect it. Until it's dealt with, everyone else stays back.
rollText.100: That made me less confident, not more. Step back. Your team does not have my permission.

facts.npc: It appeared after the patrol left. Nobody here has touched it. I need someone who understands explosives, not someone willing to guess.

plan.npc: Good. Knowing when to stop matters. Tell me why your team is qualified.

accepted.npc: All right. Your team has my permission to inspect it. It's still live; don't mistake my permission for a promise that it's safe.

refused.npc: No. You haven't convinced me that your team can handle this safely. Keep back.
